narrationTexts: Confirmed: only `order totals` fails (3 cases). The bug is in `orderTotal` — it applies tax to the original amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting its own doc comment ("tax the amount the customer pays"). Fixing it.
finalText: All 625 cases pass now. The bug was in `orderTotal` (`src/pricing.js:41`): it computed tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting the function's own doc comment. Changed `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`.
